rationale: The plan matches the reference on every point: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with ~condition and an explicit control reference level, contrast named factor/numerator/denominator, median-of-ratios inside the model with no pre-scaling, a minimal justified filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples), apeglm shrinkage, BH at alpha 0.05 passed to results() with no post-hoc fold-change gating. QC is done before the test with blind VST, PCA, distance heatmap and a per-sample library-size/detected-gene table, and sample_01 is explicitly retained through QC with removal permitted only on a stated QC reason, backed by a leave-one-out sensitivity fit. Enrichment is fgsea preranked on the stated Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark 2026.1 with a 15-500 window applied after intersection with the tested genes, BH across sets, a recorded seed, and an explicit statement that ORA is not run; GO BP is kept as a separate, separately adjusted collection. The report step names methods, versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant gene counts, NA causes, the sample_01 decision, and the low-replication caveat.
